text:
Bennie, at 102 Great Portland St, is about 0.3 miles from Oxford Circus. Its private room seats up to 26, and the listing says weekday lunchtime hire starts at £50 an hour with a 2-hour minimum. That's roomy for 10 and probably relaxed. I couldn't check noise levels or whether 7 Dec at 12:30 is free, so please ask them. Other places worth a call are Brother Marcus Soho and OKA in Kingly Court.
